contract.json: {"operationId":"getGameTimestamps","parameters":[{"description":"The unique identifier (primary key) for the specific game","in":"path","name":"game_pk","required":true,"schema":{"example":"716463","type":"string"}}],"protocol":"http","responses":{"200":{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"properties":{"timestamps":{"description":"Array of timestamp strings in format yyyymmdd_######","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}},"type":"object"}}},"description":"Successfully retrieved list of timestamps"},"404":{"description":"Game not found"}},"securitySource":"unspecified"}

{"operationId":"getLiveGameFeed","parameters":[{"description":"The unique identifier (primary key) for the specific game","in":"path","name":"game_pk","required":true,"schema":{"example":"716463","type":"string"}},{"description":"Retrieve game state at a specific timestamp in format yyyymmdd_######","in":"query","name":"timecode","required":false,"schema":{"example":"20240315_123456","pattern":"^\\d{8}_\\d{6}$","type":"string"}},{"description":"Add additional data to the response (e.g., stats, team)","in":"query","name":"hydrate","required":false,"schema":{"example":"stats,team","type":"string"}},{"description":"Limit the response to specific fields","in":"query","name":"fields","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"protocol":"http","responses":{"200":{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"properties":{"gameData":{"description":"Metadata about the game including teams, venue, and game status","type":"object"},"liveData":{"description":"Real-time game data including plays, boxscore, and current state","type":"object"}},"type":"object"}}},"description":"Successfully retrieved live game feed"},"404":{"description":"Game not found"}},"securitySource":"unspecified"}

{"operationId":"getPlayer","parameters":[{"description":"The unique identifier for the player (e.g., 660271 for Shohei Ohtani)","in":"path","name":"playerId","required":true,"schema":{"example":660271,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"Specify a season year for player information","in":"query","name":"season","required":false,"schema":{"example":2024,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"Add additional data to the response (e.g., stats, currentTeam)","in":"query","name":"hydrate","required":false,"schema":{"example":"stats,currentTeam","type":"string"}}],"protocol":"http","responses":{"200":{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"properties":{"people":{"items":{"properties":{"batSide":{"type":"object"},"birthDate":{"format":"date","type":"string"},"currentAge":{"type":"integer"},"firstName":{"type":"string"},"fullName":{"type":"string"},"height":{"type":"string"},"id":{"type":"integer"},"lastName":{"type":"string"},"pitchHand":{"type":"object"},"primaryNumber":{"type":"string"},"primaryPosition":{"properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"type":{"type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"weight":{"type":"integer"}},"type":"object"},"type":"array"}},"type":"object"}}},"description":"Successfully retrieved player information"},"404":{"description":"Player not found"}},"securitySource":"unspecified"}

{"operationId":"getSchedule","parameters":[{"description":"Sport identifier (1 = Major League Baseball)","in":"query","name":"sportId","required":false,"schema":{"default":1,"example":1,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"The season year","in":"query","name":"season","required":false,"schema":{"example":2024,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"Type of games to include (R = Regular Season, P = Postseason, S = Spring Training)","in":"query","name":"gameType","required":false,"schema":{"enum":["R","P","S"],"example":"R","type":"string"}},{"description":"Specific date for schedule (format: MM/DD/YYYY)","in":"query","name":"date","required":false,"schema":{"example":"03/15/2024","type":"string"}},{"description":"Add additional data to the response","in":"query","name":"hydrate","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"protocol":"http","responses":{"200":{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"properties":{"dates":{"items":{"properties":{"date":{"format":"date","type":"string"},"games":{"items":{"properties":{"gameDate":{"format":"date-time","type":"string"},"gamePk":{"description":"Unique game identifier","type":"integer"},"teams":{"type":"object"}},"type":"object"},"type":"array"}},"type":"object"},"type":"array"}},"type":"object"}}},"description":"Successfully retrieved schedule"}},"securitySource":"unspecified"}

{"operationId":"getTeamRoster","parameters":[{"description":"The unique identifier for the team (e.g., 119 for LA Dodgers)","in":"path","name":"teamId","required":true,"schema":{"example":119,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"The season year for the roster","in":"query","name":"season","required":false,"schema":{"example":2024,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"Add additional data to the response","in":"query","name":"hydrate","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"protocol":"http","responses":{"200":{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"properties":{"roster":{"items":{"properties":{"jerseyNumber":{"type":"string"},"person":{"properties":{"fullName":{"type":"string"},"id":{"type":"integer"}},"type":"object"},"position":{"properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"type":{"type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"status":{"type":"object"}},"type":"object"},"type":"array"}},"type":"object"}}},"description":"Successfully retrieved team roster"},"404":{"description":"Team not found"}},"securitySource":"unspecified"}

{"operationId":"getTeam","parameters":[{"description":"The unique identifier for the team (e.g., 119 for LA Dodgers)","in":"path","name":"teamId","required":true,"schema":{"example":119,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"Specify a season year for team information","in":"query","name":"season","required":false,"schema":{"example":2024,"type":"integer"}},{"description":"Add additional data to the response","in":"query","name":"hydrate","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"protocol":"http","responses":{"200":{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"properties":{"teams":{"items":{"properties":{"abbreviation":{"type":"string"},"division":{"type":"object"},"id":{"type":"integer"},"league":{"type":"object"},"locationName":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"teamName":{"type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"type":"array"}},"type":"object"}}},"description":"Successfully retrieved team information"},"404":{"description":"Team not found"}},"securitySource":"unspecified"}

info.description: The MLB GUMBO API provides real-time access to comprehensive Major League Baseball data, including live game information and player statistics. Developers can utilize this API to create applications that enhance fan engagement using advanced data insights and machine learning capabilities. The GUMBO (Grand Unified Master Baseball Object) live data feed provides a standardized JSON response that summarizes the entire state of a selected game upon each update.
